description: This file contains unit tests for the DeleteAclEntryStrategy class, which is part of a command strategy pattern in the context of a persistence actor system for things management. The tests verify immutability, error handling when ACL entries are missing or invalid, and successful deletion scenarios.

classes.name: DeleteAclEntryStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteAclEntryStrategy, verifying immutability, error handling, and successful ACL entry deletion.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DeleteAclEntryStrategy instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DeleteAclEntryStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: applyStrategyOnThingWithoutAcl
methods.description: Tests that attempting to delete an ACL entry from a thing that has no ACL results in an appropriate error.

methods.name: deleteLastAclEntryWithMinRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Tests that deleting the last ACL entry with minimal permissions triggers an invalid ACL error.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteAclEntry
methods.description: Verifies that an ACL entry can be successfully deleted and the correct response is received.
